## Action

The children emerge into the real world for the first time. The sky is impossibly large. There is no ceiling. There is no system. There is only wind.

## Gap

Kael thought leaving would feel like arrival. It feels like falling upward. The world is real, but "real" was supposed to mean something it doesn't.

## Choice

Kael keeps walking. Not toward anything. Just away from the door that was always open, and now, finally, is closed behind them.

## Shift

From "I want to escape" to "I have escaped." The prison is gone. So is the person who lived inside it.

## Development Log

Climax beat. Kael's arc completes — from passive observer to someone who chooses uncertainty over false safety. Marked is_climax=true.
